svg.title: BUDLUM LEAF · BL-DWG-002 · REV L.5.0
svg.desc: 4-Quadrant (+) Snap-Together Polycarbonate Screen-Battery Body (80 x 160 x 2.00 mm, 68 g, 12 Wh LLZO Solid-State), Portless Universal Qi2.2 Wireless Charging, and 90-Degree Bent-Stem B Module (20 g, ONLY USB-C). Revision L.5.0, 2026-10-12.
svg.text: BUDLUM LEAF · 4-QUADRANT (+) SCREEN-BATTERY (72 G), PORTLESS Qİ2 BODY & 90° B MODULE (22 G)
Drawing BL-DWG-002 · Revision L.5.0 · 2026-10-12 · 4 x (40 x 80 x 2.00 mm) (+) Polycarbonate Tiles (12 Wh LLZO Solid-State, Qi2.2) · 90°-Bent-Stem B Module (ONLY USB-C)
A · THE 2.20 MM 4-QUADRANT (+) SCREEN-BATTERY STACK (18 G / TILE)
Bulky bottom battery dropped: 4 snap-together 40 x 80 x 2.00 mm tiles hold 4 x 3.0 Wh = 12.0 Wh LLZO solid-state cells.
Front ISO 10993 Polycarbonate (0.20) + DC-Dimming T-OLED (0.14)
AgNW/ITO + Corning edge-wrapped 0.00 mm zero-bezel conductors (0.04 mm)
PDLC Privacy + Orthotropic Graphene / Mu-Metal Ocular Shield (0.09 mm)
Non-Flammable LLZO / PEO-Ceramic Solid-State Cell (3.0 Wh / Tile)
0% liquid solvent, 0% LiPF6 salt, 0.0 ppm toxic HF gas, 0% swelling
Eyewear-safe: ocular face <=36.2 C, ELF <0.08 uT, SAR = 0.054 W/kg
<15 um n=1.585 self-healing optical seam lip (zero scratch / zero line)
Universal Qi2.2 MPP (Ø54 mm) + local Ø22 mm Qi coil (zero USB-C on body)
(+) TITANIUM HUB + 24 N52H MAGNETS + 64 GOLD MICRO-LEAVES
Back ISO 10993 Polycarbonate (0.20) + DC-Dimming T-OLED (0.14)
1.16 LLZO
1. Phone divides across the center (+) into 4 equal 40 x 80 x 2.00 mm polycarbonate tiles (Q1..Q4, 4 x 17 g = 68 g).
2. 12 um n=1.585 optical elastomer lip + Corning edge-wrapped electrodes make the (+) joint 100% invisible (0 scratch).
3. Each tile holds a 3.0 Wh non-flammable LLZO/PEO solid-state battery (12.0 Wh total, EU 2023/1542 <3 s swap).
4. Portless body has ZERO USB-C and ZERO buttons; charges on any Qi / Qi2.2 wireless pad (15-25 W).
5. 90°-Bent-Stem B module holds the ONLY USB Type-C port, Zero-CPU UWB/60GHz SiP, Master TCON, and 50MP cam.
B · 4-QUADRANT (+) SOLID-STATE TILES & 90°-BENT-STEM B MODULE
4 tiles snap across the (+) cross; ONLY the B stem is bent at 90° while the round ring sits ON the screen.
2.00 mm quad
4-QUADRANT (+) TILES · 4 x 3.0 Wh = 12.0 Wh LLZO
Central Grade-5 Titanium Cruciform (+) Hub + 8 micro-dovetail pins
24 bipolar N52H magnets + 64 gold micro-leaves (3 ms Dead-Pad)
<15 um n=1.585 phenyl-fluorosilicone self-healing optical seam (IP68)
Biocompatible ISO 10993 PC + <=36.2 C ocular thermal limiter
Bifilar current-canceling tabs + Mu-metal shield (ELF <0.08 uT)
Universal Qi2.2 MPP Ø54 mm 4-sector coil + 4x Ø22 mm local Qi coils
EU 2023/1542 Art. 11: <3 s tool-free hot-swap of any single quadrant
<3 s (+) swap
B2 · THE 90°-BENT-STEM B MODULE (22.0 G · 32 INTERNAL PARTS)
90°-BENT B STEM
RING ON SCREEN
• ONLY the stem (cubuk, 32 x 4 x 1 mm) bends at 90° and stays above edge.
• Round ring (32 x 32 x 4.00 mm) lies flat ON TOP OF the screen surface.
• Houses the ONLY USB Type-C (40W), LCP + 60GHz antenna, TCON, UWB.
• +/-90° Ti hinge docks to FRONT or BACK of screen and all 4 edges.
C · 80.0 x 160.0 x 4.00 MM RECTANGULAR PRISM · ALL 12 EDGES SOFTENED
Upright 80 x 160 mm
+ top-left upright B
Geometry of the 12 Softened Prism Edges (No 32 mm Oval Corners)
• 4 vertical corner edges: small tactile radius R = 6.35 mm (screen corner R = 1.40 mm).
• 4 front + 4 back horizontal perimeter edges: softened with r = 0.80 mm radius transition.
• Flat edge gripping land along all 4 sides: 4.00 - 2(0.80) = 2.40 mm.
• Active screen area per face: 76.4 x 156.4 mm = 11,947 mm² (100% open, 0 mm² covered).
• Resolution: 1,528 x 3,128 px at 508 ppi (1-144 Hz LTPO, 1,200 nits peak).
• B module (40.0 x 32.0 x 4.00 mm) all 90° edges softened at r = 0.55 mm.
Why Small Edge Softening Replaces Giant 32 mm Corners
A 32 mm corner radius on an 80 mm wide screen cuts off the corners into a capsule and wastes
869 mm² of display. With R = 6.35 mm corners and r = 0.80 mm on all 12 prism edges, the
phone keeps a true rectangular screen while eliminating every sharp 90° edge in the hand.
D · 4-QUADRANT (+) BIOCOMPATIBLE SOLID-STATE BATTERY FAMILY
Leaf 160 4-Quadrant (+) Body: 4 x (40.0 x 80.0 x 2.00 mm) tiles = 12.0 Wh non-flammable LLZO/PEO + Qi2.2 coils
Member / Architecture
Layers
Delivered
Mass
Strain @ R25.5
Why the LLZO/PEO Solid-State Battery is Safe for Eyewear, Hand & Pocket
Inorganic LLZO ceramic + PEO polymer electrolyte has 0% liquid solvent and 0% LiPF6 (0.0 ppm HF gas, non-flammable).
Orthotropic graphene + Mu-metal shield and NTC limiter keep ocular face <=36.2 C, ELF <0.08 uT, and SAR 0.054 W/kg.
Portless body charges on any Qi / Qi2.2 wireless pad; the ONLY USB Type-C port sits inside the 90°-bent B stem.
E · SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE (REV L.5.0) · 4-QUADRANT (+) BODY + 90°-BENT-STEM B MODULE
IN THE HAND · 68 g 4-Quadrant (+) Body + 20 g B = 88 g

g.text: • Dual ISO 10993 polycarbonate + DC-dimming T-OLED + PDLC privacy
• 4 x 3.0 Wh = 12.0 Wh LLZO solid-state battery + Qi2.2/Qi wireless coils
• 90°-Bent-Stem B module (20 g, r 0.55 mm softened edges):
- ONLY the stem bends at 90° (holds LCP/60GHz antenna + ONLY USB-C)
- Round ring sits ON screen: 50MP OIS cam + rear Ø22.4 mm AMOLED
- +/-90° Ti hinge docks to FRONT or BACK of screen and all 4 edges

svg.text: AT A DISTANCE · Room or Cloud Validator + B.U.D.

g.text: • Heavy CPU / GPU / AI compute runs on room or cloud validators
• Compositor, encoder, and AI model execution with STARK verification
• Fail-closed settlement: no proof, no credit
• User state and geometry manifest stored in B.U.D.
• B module 6L PCBA holds Quad-Tile Master TCON + UWB/60GHz SiP
• Without B module, body charges wirelessly; all active tasks require B
• Each quadrant tile swaps tool-free in <3 s (EU 2023/1542 Art. 11)
• 90°-Bent B stem: Wi-Fi 7 tri-band + BT 5.4 + UWB LCP
• 90°-Bent B stem ridge: 1x4 60 GHz mmWave patch array
• 90°-Bent B stem: ONLY USB Type-C (40W PD 3.1 + DP 2.1)
• Central (+) Qi2.2 MPP Ø54 mm 4-sector coil (15-25 W)
• 4 x Ø22 mm local Qi coils (single tile wireless charge)
• Eyewear mode Head/Eye SAR = 0.054 W/kg (<0.08 uT ELF)
• Multipath MPTCP / QUIC with fail-safe local screen mode

svg.text: VERIFICATION SUMMARY · REVISION L.5.0

g.text: • 4-Quadrant (+) Screen-Battery Body: 4 x (40 x 80 x 2.00 mm) = 80 x 160 x 2.00 mm (68 g, 52 internal parts), <15 um n=1.585 zero-scratch optical seam (F-01 to F-10).
• 90°-Bent-Stem B Module: 20.0 g (32 internal parts), ONLY stem bent at 90° (LCP/60GHz antenna + ONLY USB-C), round ring ON screen, reversible Front/Back & 4 edges (MON-1 to MON-20).
• Biocompatible Eyewear-Safe LLZO Solid-State Battery (4 x 3.0 Wh = 12.0 Wh, <=36.2 C, 0 HF, SAR 0.054 W/kg) + Portless Universal Qi/Qi2.2 Wireless Charging (ENR-11 to ENR-21).

svg.text: Closed items: K1 = 2.00 mm 4-quadrant (+) body (68 g) + 4.00 mm B ring (20 g = 88 g total) · Q1 = Universal Qi2.2 wireless on body, USB-C ONLY on B stem · Revision L.5.0, 2026-10-12.
